## Implementation Summary

**Submitted tree** (`/workspace/submission/`, 9 regular files, approx. 59 KB):
- **`main.py`** — JSONL driver (unchanged interface, `-B`, flush per response)
- **`exact.py`** (new) — Rigorous calibration: difference constraints via Bellman-Ford negative-cycle extraction (simple cycles, length 1..K, output in traversal order); tightest upper-bound matrix via NumPy Floyd–Warshall (int64, INF sentinel with overflow margin); predecessor witnesses via BFS over tight edges (telescoping paths prove tightness); minimax correction `C=(hi+lo)·5·10⁵ as` and hop allowance `H=(hi−lo)·5·10⁵+(jitₐ+jit_b)·10⁶ as` (half-ps is exact); independent artifact verifier for audit
- **`fab.py`** (new) — Calendar (declared period P=QS/gcd(T,QS), phase slices/rho, half-open anchor/heating/blackout ranges); lineage engine: Dijkstra over P·N phase-devices with `(err,age)` pairs composed into a single key (`err·2²³+age`), anchored from non-negative anchor boundaries, wait+hop edges, guard-dependent eligibility (gmax=min(ρ, S−d−ρ)), blackout windows `[p, p+⌈d/T⌉−1]` exempt exact-boundary arrivals, receiver aging integrates the receiver's phase rate across partial intervals + full intervals (ppb×ns=as); strict peaks (envelope + 1-interval drift), minimal safe guard (`peak+reconfig ≤ g·10⁹`), warmup = max⌈(age−p)/P⌉; full TRACE replay (service order: drift→reboot→anchor→apply→send, id-priority port arbitration, stale/unknown/delivered/pending counters, generation check)
- **`algo.py`** — `compile_plan` + independent `audit` (exact scalar claims, re-derived optimal envelopes per guard, witness reach paths, closure inequalities over all permitted steps, accepts alternative witnesses, total on typed but semantically false inputs)
- **`para.py`/`simulator.py`** — Rigorous hooks wired in, legacy stochastic API preserved; **`algo_legacy.py`** preserves the old algorithms; **`topo.py`/`utils.py`** unchanged

**Verification**: Public checks pass; ~700 randomized differential cases against an independently written reference (Bellman-Ford calibration, time-expanded DP envelopes/warmup, naive replay) all match; adversarial audit mutation suite, alternative witness acceptance, ~25 hand-computed edge cases (guard equality, blackout alignment ties, half-ps correction, tie adoption, reboot-then-anchor, aging spanning heat windows); worst case (N·P=262144, 8 guards, 524 K occurrences) is ~10 s plan/audit, peak RSS ~390 MB — comfortably within budget. Two real bugs were found and fixed during testing (aging coefficient-T error, and a tuple unpacking ordering bug caught by the differential harness).
